svg.title: Vertical scaling
svg.desc: A dashboard app queries one Postgres server with 4 cores and 32 GB. The hot data does not fit in memory, so reads go to disk and slow loads take 900 ms. The server is resized to 16 cores and 128 GB, the hot data fits, and slow loads drop to 120 ms. It grows again and hits the ceiling, the largest machine you can buy.
svg.text: A bigger box fits the hot data in memory, until there is no bigger box.
